compat.text: SikaRoof® PUR-20 UV is a spray applied, seamless, highly elastic and UV-stable hybrid polyurethane roof waterproofing system consisting of Sikalastic®- 888 Hybrid and Sikalastic®-701. Suitable for use in hot and tropical climatic conditions.
compat.heading: DESCRIPTION

compat.text: SikaRoof® PUR-20 UV can be used as following: Roof waterproofing solution for new construction and refurbishment projects
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Do not apply SikaRoof® PUR on substrates with rising moisture.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: SikaRoof® PUR is not suitable for permanent water immersion.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use SikaRoof® PUR for indoor applications.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not apply close to the air intake vent of a running air conditioning unit.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not apply SikaRoof® PUR directly on insulation boards.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not apply cementitious products (e.g. tile mortar) directly onto SikaRoof® PUR.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: concrete, metal, brickwork, asbestos cement, ceramic tiles.
